name: heavenlykey-platform
description: Global Christian Platform + Ministry Management Suite backend — Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.deploy: npm run preflight && npx --yes wrangler@4.151.1 deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run preflight && npx --yes wrangler@4.151.1 deploy --env staging
scripts.migrate:local: npx --yes wrangler@4.151.1 d1 migrations apply heavenlykey-db --local
scripts.migrate:staging: npx --yes wrangler@4.151.1 d1 migrations apply heavenlykey-db-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.migrate:prod: npx --yes wrangler@4.151.1 d1 migrations apply heavenlykey-db --remote
